description: This file defines the interface and data structures for integrating native Android application code with the Android system, including callbacks, app state management, and event handling.

classes.name: android_app
classes.description: Represents the state and callbacks for a native Android application, including event handling, activity state, and input/output interfaces.

classes.name: android_poll_source
classes.description: Represents a source of events for the application's looper, including a process callback.

methods.name: android_app_read_cmd
methods.description: Reads the next command message from the application's main thread.

methods.name: android_app_pre_exec_cmd
methods.description: Performs initial processing of a command received from the main thread.

methods.name: android_app_post_exec_cmd
methods.description: Performs final processing after handling a command.

methods.name: app_dummy
methods.description: Dummy function to prevent stripping of glue code.

methods.name: android_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the native application code, to be implemented by the app.
